english.text: Meanwhile from neighbouring Tenedos once more, / beneath the tranquil moonbeam's friendly care, / with ordered ships, along the deep sea-floor, / back came the Argive host, and sought the well-known shore. / Forth from the royal galley sprang the flame, / when Sinon, screened by partial Fate, withdrew / the bolts and barriers of the pinewood frame, / and from its inmost caverns, bared to view, / the fatal horse disgorged the Danaan crew.

text: 同時，再次從鄰近嘅特內多斯， / 喺寧靜嘅月光嘅友好照顧之下， / 有秩序嘅船隻，沿住深海嘅海底， / 返嚟嘅係阿吉夫嘅主人，並且尋求著名嘅海岸 / 從皇家廚房跳出嚟 火焰， / 當西諾，被部分命運篩選，撤回 / 松木框架嘅螺栓同障礙物， / 同埋從佢最入面嘅洞穴，裸露到景色， / 致命嘅馬吐出咗達南船員。

english.text: Every one answered according as they had heard. Some said that it was an old haunted castle, others that all the witches of the country held their midnight revels there, but the common opinion was that it was an ogre's dwelling, and that he carried to it all the little children he could catch, so as to eat them up at his leisure, without any one being able to follow him, for he alone had the power to make his way through the wood.

text: 每個人都照佢哋聽過嘅嘢答。有人話呢個係一個舊嘅鬼屋城堡，有人話呢個國家所有嘅巫婆都喺嗰度舉行午夜狂歡，但係普遍嘅意見係，呢度係一個食人魔嘅住所，而佢將所有佢捉到嘅細路仔都帶去嗰度，等佢閒時食晒佢哋，而冇人可以跟住佢，因為只有佢有能力穿過樹林。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: After 17:00 this 1st of June of 2025, I was at sunny Tim Hortons café here on Lulu Island to enjoy an Iced Classic Lemonade and a Turkey Bacon Club Artisan Sandwich. My friend Gustavo's all-Brazilian foursome family arrived to buy donut holes. He and his wife have two young girls. All four family members seem triracial: white, red, and black. But they all look very much predominantly white. I mentioned to myself that Brazil is a much whiter country than my homeland, the Philippines. "Tudo bem!" in Portuguese I exclaimed (All good!).

jyutping: hai2 2025 nin4 6 jyut6 1 hou6 ge3 5 dim2 zi1 hau6，ngo5 hai2 nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 joeng4 gwong1 pou2 ziu3 ge3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 dou6 hoeng2 jung6 bing1 dung3 ging1 din2 ning4 mung1 seoi2 tung4 fo2 gai1 jin1 juk6 keoi1 lok6 bou6 sau2 gung1 saam1 man4 zi6。ngo5 pang4 jau5 Gustavo ge3 cyun4 baa1 sai1 sei3 jan4 gaa1 ting4 dou3 zo2 lai4 maai5 tim4 tim4 hyun1 dung6。keoi5 tung4 keoi5 lou5 po4 jau5 loeng5 go3 hau6 saang1 neoi2。sei3 go3 gaa1 ting4 sing4 jyun4 dou1 hou2 ci5 hai6 saam1 zung2 zuk6：baak6 jan4、hung4 sik1 tung4 haak1 jan4。daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 tai2 lok6 hou2 ji5 baak6 sik1 wai4 zyu2。ngo5 tung4 zi6 gei2 tai4 gwo3，baa1 sai1 hai6 jat1 go3 bei2 ngo5 ge3 zou2 gwok3 fei1 leot6 ban1 baak6 hou2 do1 ge3 gwok3 gaa1。「 Tudo bem ！」ngo5 jung6 pou4 tou4 ngaa4 man4 haam3 dou6（jat1 cai3 dou1 hou2！）。
text: 喺2025年6月1號嘅5點之後，我喺呢度露露島嘅陽光普照嘅 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳度享用冰凍經典檸檬水同火雞煙肉俱樂部手工三文治。我朋友 Gustavo 嘅全巴西四人家庭到咗嚟買甜甜圈洞。佢同佢老婆有兩個後生女。四個家庭成員都好似係三種族：白人、紅色同黑人。但係佢哋全部都睇落好以白色為主。我同自己提過，巴西係一個比我嘅祖國菲律賓白好多嘅國家。「 Tudo bem ！」我用葡萄牙文喊道（一切都好！）。
